text_block_list.text:
Even just the announcement of Symboli
Rudolf's
debut race has caused quite a
stir in the racing
world, but she herself
seems unfazed by the
attention.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She has told me her objectives: first to
claim the
Classic Triple Crown, then to
cement her status as
the true Emperor
with further accolades.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Together, we set out to realize her
vision: a world
in which all Umamusume
can live in bliss!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
